overall_reason: The deploy card's status icons keep their meaning (green live, grey building, red failed), but the action is a framework indigo #4f46e5 and the card and icons sit in indigo and cyan glows with no brand behind them.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES passes for the states, while T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds a default indigo accent and T-SURFACE-LADDER finds three shadow recipes, two of them coloured glows.

findings.title: Colour has a source
findings.evidence: The only chromatic group is #4f46e5 (hue 277), the framework's indigo, on the Deploy fill, with a card ring rgba(99,102,241) and a cyan #22d3ee halo; nothing in the frame sources it. The sweep's glow detector flags the indigo and cyan glows (SLP-008).
findings.before: Framework indigo #4f46e5 as the accent, with indigo and cyan glows
findings.after: An accent sampled from the product's own brand, held to the action, with no glow
findings.why: A default indigo with glows reads as a generator's palette, not this product's.

findings.title: Depth comes from lightness and one shadow
findings.evidence: The palette table finds 3 shadow recipes: an inset hairline, an indigo ring with a 0.4 alpha indigo spread, and 'rgba(99,102,241,0.8) 0 0 14px' with a #a5b4fc ring; the tile also shows green and red halos around the status icons.
findings.before: Three shadow recipes, two of them coloured glows
findings.after: One neutral shadow recipe for the card and no glow on the icons
findings.why: Coloured glows add a second depth system and blur the state icons.

strengths: State colours keep their meaning: green for live, grey for building, red for failed.
Text is untinted greys (#1f1f1f ink, #8a8a8a and #9a9a9a meta).
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
